answer: A 70-credit bond in 3 layers stops fakes: basalt 30 for registration, one key per claim. The saffron layer holds 25 behind a sealed receipt, checked by auditors each epoch. The zenith layer holds 15, released only if all three match one key at the checkpoint, or burns. Rented receipts carry the owner's key, so borrowed layers misalign. First fake 46, k-th 46+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,043,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool; honest pays 46 once.
